about_the_game:
What do You Call a Group of Skeletons is a short comedy puzzle adventure featuring a (you guessed it) group of skeletons.

You are a part of the Mobile Milk Brigade, a group of anarchistic skeletons looking for hip new sources of calcium. Your journey has led you to "the Hospital", where Craig the great inventor and famous skeleton denier has been living in recluse for many years.

Can you convince Craig to give up his unfinished milk supplement?

The Mobile Milk Brigade is a colourful cast of characters, including your long time friend Wrangler Bones, the ever profit driven Money Bones, and many more. In between exploring sessions you will get the chance to talk to them and learn more about the world and story as it progresses.

The Hospital is a strange collection of rooms and corridors that lead nowhere, with puzzles scattered across blocking your way. You will need arms, brains, and guts to beat it all.

The pinnacle of all collectibles, and driving force of everyone's daily motivation!
